_scope.deferredReason: Source files are 830x563. Every non-transparency template region in the catalogue is larger than 830px, so a create would require an upscale. T36: upscaling adds no detail, and there is no update endpoint (T03), so a bad create is permanent. Blocked on high-res masters from Rory.
_scope.apparelNote: 9 templates DO fit all 11 artworks at 450x336 (DTG/DTFX tees, hoodies, sweatshirts, polo) — measured against all 605 templates in fw-revops/fw-templates-skill/working/catalog_details.json. Every one requires cutout transparency, which T36 measured as unmanufacturable from JPEG. Blocked on transparent PNG masters, not on template availability.

artworks.name: Lobedicus
artworks.description: "Lobedicus" by Rory Skagen. Original painting, reproduced as a soy wax candle in a clear glass jar. Full-bleed print on the label, so the artwork wraps the vessel. Hand-poured soy wax with a natural scent that suits a room rather than shouting over it. Doubles as home decor — the kind of object you notice because it looks like a picture first and a candle second.

templates.templateName: Soy Wax Candle In A Clear Glass Jar
templates._fit: Artwork 1500x1000 vs region 1191x720: retained 87%, covers 1.26. Passes (>=85% retained, >=1.0 covers). No upscale.
templates._onlyOption: Of 45 JPEG-safe (non-transparency) templates this is the ONLY region that fits these three. Apparel fits too but needs alpha -> T36.
templates._pricing: Template base is $12.95. profitMargin is a USD amount on top of base, not a percentage. This reproduces the existing live candles exactly ($25.90 retail), which verified at $25.90 on the Gondoleu product. 100% markup on cost.
templates._sizesNote: The template publishes exactly one size. Sent explicitly anyway — omitting sizes creates exactly one variant as a side effect (T06), and being explicit keeps the intent legible.
templates._publishNote: FALSE. publishOnCreate is create-time-only and there is no publish endpoint (T37), so this is a deliberate one-way door: hidden now, dashboard click later. Never set true for a bulk create.

_collectionWarning: T04/T05: the collection slug is minted by Fourthwall from the NAME, so passing 'candles' does not control it — the previous release produced 'museum-canvas-archival-prints' from 'Museum Canvas & Archival Prints' and the taxonomy title no longer overrode it. Also PUT /collections/{id}/products REPLACES the entire list, so a partial send silently drops the others. Verify by re-reading the collection after applying, not by trusting a 200.
